algorithm: sha1(normalised text) truncated to 16 hex chars
normalisation: lowercase; words = regex [a-z0-9']+ ; joined by single spaces. Names/orgs: every 1-4 word window of a string is checked. Copy: full strings of >= fullStringMinWords words and every shingleSize-word shingle.
provenance: persons/orgs/customer domains hashed from the clone source (src/content, src/components); copy and CTA hashes computed in-page from the rendered clone at 1440px on all 18 routes (2026-10-27). Plain text is never stored.
